name: llm-free-cascade
description: Cascade a chat completion across every free-tier LLM API you have a key for (Groq, Gemini, Mistral, NVIDIA NIM, Z.ai, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, ModelScope, Cloudflare, Cohere, and more) with per-key and per-model rotation, reset-aware cooldowns, custom/gateway providers, stats, streaming, and a paid last-resort fallback.

scripts.test: node --test test/cascade.test.js test/plan.test.js test/server.test.js test/audit.test.js test/cli.test.js
scripts.check:types: npx --yes -p typescript@5.9.3 -p @types/node@22 tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck test/types-check.ts

author: Ram Chandra Giri
